title: Kissed Caramel Ukrainian Andouille Skillet
description: A nutty and juicy Ukrainian dish featuring caramelized Andouille sausage, this festive skillet is perfect for special occasions and is low-sodium-friendly.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the sliced Andouille sausage.
Cook the sausage for 5 minutes, or until browned, then remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, or until caramelized.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the skillet and cook for 10 minutes, or until tender.
Add the chicken broth, brown sugar, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the cooked sausage to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and sauce.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the skillet for 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
